issue.title: Stop the Agents-tab @epic tribe panel from flickering
issue.description: The Agents-tab @epic tribe panel stays mounted as a tribe-keyed widget across disk applies, proc-shell sync, bounded loads, and sibling-tribe occupancy churn: one logical apply publishes one roster, incomplete bounded loads never delete by omission, and a standing filter query no longer forces a full rebuild of untouched panels.

issue.title: Publish one aggregate roster per disk apply
issue.description: atomic-roster-publication: merge the generation-stamped proc projection into the disk/cached roster before the single finalize, rebase if the generation moved during the worker, and cover the empty-disk plus live-projection regression.

issue.title: Key AgentList widgets by tribe and stop blanking untouched panels
issue.description: tribe-stable-widgets: give each tribe a stable widget id, insert or remove one panel without rebuilding siblings, skip clear_options on unchanged row sets, and finish the standing-query row-remove path.

issue.title: Stop incomplete bounded loads from replacing a larger cache
issue.description: removal-authority: patch same-query bounded loads regardless of has_more, keep a nonempty cache across a bounded zero, clear the complete-history latch only on a committed-query change, and converge revalidate with auto-refresh.

issue.title: Prove panel stability on the live host with traces
issue.description: verify-on-athena: restart onto the landed tree, soak under by_status and the standing NOT machine:apollo query, and assert from traces that @epic never unmounts and one apply never publishes N then 0 then N.

FINALIZE-PLAN FIX + ATHENA SOAK EVIDENCE (bead NOT closed; see 'Not met' below).

DIAGNOSIS CORRECTION. The plan (finalize_plan_drops_fleet_rows) attributed the 2->1->2 panel dips to the precomputed finalize plan republishing a local-only roster and dropping fleet rows. That defect is real (fixed: row-fingerprint guard + fleet rows projected before planning) but is NOT what caused the dips on athena: under NOT machine:apollo all 28 fleet rows are filtered out on every path. The soak showed the real cause: @epic is made of LOCAL clan containers, and the load-apply path folded the roster first and projected after. project_clan_tree rebuilds a clan container only from member rows it still sees, and a collapsed clan's fold hides every member, so the container (and the whole @epic panel) vanished from any roster published by the inline path. The old plan path masked this (its local-only roster kept the containers); the 3 dips in the earlier soak were the applies whose plan was DISCARDED by the stale token, not the ones that applied it. Evidence: a startup apply with finalize_plan=absent published 6 rows (no epic) while the fleet_refresh reproject a second later, from the same rows, published 7 (epic clan present). Applying step 2+3 alone made it systematic (plan applied every time -> dip on every apply; ~/.sase/perf/sase-13i.4-soak2-attempt1-tui_trace.jsonl, killed after 41s). Fix: the boundary now projects fleet rows and THEN folds (project_and_fold_rosters), which is how _reproject_agents_from_current_mode and _refilter_agents already derive the roster; the load-apply path was the only producer folding first. This deliberately reverses the plan's 'do not change fold/projection order' bullet, which rested on the wrong diagnosis. The repro invariant (visible_roster_omits_unfiltered) does NOT exempt clan containers, so it flags this defect class.
